title: Weak synchronisation for McKean--Vlasov SDEs
summary: Synchronisation by noise for McKean--Vlasov stochastic differential equations is investigated. A transfer principle is introduced by which synchronisation by noise and diagonal mixing can be transferred from an associated limiting frozen-diffusion SDE to a genuinely law-dependent McKean--Vlasov SDE. The usefulness of this principle is demonstrated through an application to ensemble Kalman sampling, thereby providing its first application in a sampling context.
